title: Giants using their underdog ‘humbling’ as fuel for pivotal Commanders clash

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants using their underdog ‘humbling’ as fuel for pivotal Commanders clash
sources.description: Off to a surprising 3-1 start, the Giants are aware that their back-to-back last-minute wins against the hapless Titans and Cardinals have not changed public skepticism about their legitimacy as a contender.
